"""SEC_RBAC Gate 1D: deny privileged catalogue operations without explicit SQL RBAC_ADMIN."""
import ast
from pathlib import Path

import pytest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "modules"
GUARDED = (
    ("catalogos_workflow_compat/routes.py", "compat_put_catalogo_niveles"),
    ("catalogos_workflow_compat/routes.py", "compat_post_permisos_catalogo"),
    ("catalogos_workflow_compat/routes.py", "compat_get_permisos_catalogo"),
    ("catalogos_workflow_sql/routes.py", "put_catalogo_niveles"),
    ("catalogos_workflow_sql/routes.py", "post_permisos_catalogo"),
    ("catalogos_workflow_sql/routes.py", "get_permisos_catalogo"),
)


def _find(path, name):
    module = ast.parse((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return next(
        node for node in module.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.AsyncFunctionDef) and node.name == name
    )


def _has_explicit_guard(function):
    return any(
        isinstance(default, ast.Call)
        and isinstance(default.func, ast.Name)
        and default.func.id == "Depends"
        and len(default.args) == 1
        and isinstance(default.args[0], ast.Call)
        and isinstance(default.args[0].func, ast.Name)
        and default.args[0].func.id == "require_explicit_permission"
        and len(default.args[0].args) == 1
        and isinstance(default.args[0].args[0], ast.Constant)
        and default.args[0].args[0].value == "RBAC_ADMIN"
        for default in function.args.defaults
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("path,name", GUARDED)
def test_catalog_privileged_route_requires_explicit_rbac_admin(path, name):
    assert _has_explicit_guard(_find(path, name)), (path, name)


def test_self_service_read_keeps_normal_authentication():
    assert not _has_explicit_guard(
        _find("catalogos_workflow_compat/routes.py", "compat_get_mis_permisos_catalogos")
    )
